description: Sabaragamuwa Province - The Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Appropriation (Amendment) Statute Nos. 01, 02 and 03 of 2015
categorisation: This gazette content contains the full text of two provincial appropriation amendment statutes (No. 02 of 2015 and No. 01 of 2015) that amend previous appropriation statutes. It involves legal amendments to financial limits and accounts for various provincial departments, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and legislative amendments.
